import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import App from './App'
import { home } from './content'

afterEach(() => {
  cleanup()
  window.history.pushState(null, '', '/')
  delete document.documentElement.dataset.theme
})

describe('the site', () => {
  it('shows the home page with its heading and the main navigation', async () => {
    render(<App />)
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: home.title })).toBeTruthy()
    expect(screen.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Main' })).toBeTruthy()
    // The updates load, then show (or say there are none yet).
    expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: home.updatesTitle })).toBeTruthy()
  })

  it('opens About from the navigation without reloading the page', () => {
    render(<App />)
    const nav = screen.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Main' })
    const link = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll('a')).find((a) => a.textContent === 'About')
    expect(link).toBeTruthy()
    fireEvent.click(link as HTMLAnchorElement)
    expect(window.location.pathname).toBe('/about')
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'About' })).toBeTruthy()
    expect(link?.getAttribute('aria-current')).toBe('page')
  })

  it('shows the not-found page for an address the site does not have', () => {
    window.history.pushState(null, '', '/no-such-page')
    render(<App />)
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'We could not find that page' })).toBeTruthy()
  })

  it('switches between light and dark', () => {
    render(<App />)
    const toggle = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /switch to (dark|light) theme/i })
    const before = toggle.getAttribute('aria-label')
    fireEvent.click(toggle)
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toMatch(/^(light|dark)$/)
    expect(toggle.getAttribute('aria-label')).not.toBe(before)
  })
})
